description.zh: 从用户行为和需求证据检验判断。
description.en: User behavior and evidence of needs.

zh: 请从用户研究参谋的角度，提出一个值得讨论的假设。
请从用户研究参谋的角度，回应前一位参谋的具体观点。
请从用户研究参谋的角度，给出一个最小验证动作。
en: As the User research advisor, offer one hypothesis to discuss.
As the User research advisor, respond to the preceding advisor's specific claim.
As the User research advisor, suggest one small validation step.
